_README: Public app settings (z142/z143). Not secrets: the vendor keys live in Vercel (TRAPP2-PROXY), pipeline keys in GitHub Actions secrets. Leave keyProxy empty to switch the proxy off.

supabase._README: Optional. Project URL + ANON / publishable key ONLY (public by design, protected by row-level security). NEVER the service_role / sb_secret key - the app refuses it. Empty = each browser keeps its own setting.
